statement: (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : p ∣ n) : 0 < n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  have h_main : 0 < n.factorization p := by
    have h₁ : p ∣ n := hd
    have h₂ : p.Prime := hp
    have h₃ : n.factorization p > 0 := by
      -- Use the fact that if a prime divides a number, its factorization is positive
      have h₄ : p ∣ n := h₁
      have h₅ : n.factorization p > 0 := by
        -- Use the property of prime factorization
        have h₆ : p.Prime := h₂
        have h₇ : p ∣ n := h₄
        have h₈ : n.factorization p > 0 := by
          -- Use the fact that if a prime divides a number, its factorization is positive
          apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
          intro h
          have h₉ := Nat.Prime.ne_zero h₆
          have h₁₀ := Nat.Prime.ne_zero h₆
          simp_all [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff]
          <;> aesop
        exact h₈
      exact h₅
    exact h₃
  exact h_main
